WITH emp_base AS ( SELECT t1.* , f_get_empTrans(t1.emp01_person_id, #{closeDate}::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp01_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(t1.emp01_person_id, #{closeDate}::date, 'pos_nm') AS emp01_pos_nm FROM emp01_person t1 INNER JOIN emp03_trans t2 ON t2.emp03_person_id = t1.emp01_person_id WHERE 1=1 AND t1.emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND t1.emp01_person_id = #{personId} AND t2.emp03_trans_cd <= '799' AND t2.emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = t1.emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date::date <= #{closeDate}::date ) ), calendar_base AS ( SELECT sys12_company_id , sys12_day , sys12_working_yn , sys12_off_reason FROM sys12_calendar WHERE 1=1 AND sys12_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys12_day::date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{closeDate}::date
), commute_base AS ( SELECT c.* , h.att04_after_in , h.att04_after_out , COALESCE(h.att04_after_in, c.att02_check_in_time) AS final_in , COALESCE(h.att04_after_out, c.att02_check_out_time) AS final_out , ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.att02_admin_check_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '99' WHEN COALESCE(h.att04_after_in, c.att02_check_in_time) > ( c.att02_work_date::date + wp.att01_work_start_time::time + (COALESCE(wp.att01_start_grace_after_minutes,0) * INTERVAL '1 minute') ) THEN '60' WHEN COALESCE(h.att04_after_out, c.att02_check_out_time) IS NULL THEN '00' WHEN COALESCE(c.att02_ext_check_out_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '70' WHEN COALESCE(h.att04_after_in, c.att02_check_in_time)::date != c.att02_check_out_time::date THEN '50' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM att03_overtime_req o LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr a ON a.apr01_appr_id = o.att03_appr_id WHERE COALESCE(a.apr01_status_cd, '99') = '30' AND o.att03_person_id = c.att02_person_id AND o.att03_work_date::date = c.att02_work_date::date ) THEN '40' WHEN COALESCE(h.att04_after_out, c.att02_check_out_time) > ( c.att02_work_date::date + wp.att01_work_end_time::time + (COALESCE(wp.att01_end_grace_after_minutes,0) * INTERVAL '1 minute') ) THEN '30' WHEN COALESCE(h.att04_after_out, c.att02_check_out_time) < ( c.att02_work_date::date + wp.att01_work_end_time::time - (COALESCE(wp.att01_end_grace_before_minutes,0) * INTERVAL '1 minute') ) THEN '20' ELSE '10' END ) AS att02_status_cd FROM att02_commute c INNER JOIN att01_work_policy wp ON wp.att01_company_id = c.att02_company_id AND wp.att01_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(att01_start_date) FROM att01_work_policy WHERE att01_company_id = c.att02_company_id AND att01_start_date <= c.att02_work_date )
LEFT OUTER JOIN att04_commute_hist h ON h.att04_commute_id = c.att02_commute_id ), leave_base AS ( SELECT DISTINCT l.emp20_person_id , l.emp20_start_date , l.emp20_close_date , l.emp20_leave_cd FROM emp20_leave l INNER JOIN apr01_appr a ON a.apr01_appr_id = l.emp20_appr_id AND a.apr01_status_cd != '99' ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS commute_id , e.emp01_org_nm AS org_name , e.emp01_pos_nm AS pos_name , e.emp01_emp_no AS person_no , e.emp01_kor_nm AS person_name , CASE WHEN lb.emp20_person_id IS NOT NULL THEN f_cdnm('leaveCode', lb.emp20_leave_cd, e.emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) WHEN cb.att02_commute_id IS NOT NULL THEN f_cdnm('CommuteStatusCode', cb.att02_status_cd, cb.att02_company_id, f_sysdate()) ELSE '미출근' END AS status_name
, d.sys12_day AS work_date , cb.att02_actual_minutes AS actual_minutes , cb.att02_calc_minutes AS calc_minutes , cb.att02_in_reason AS in_reason , cb.att02_out_reason AS out_reason , TO_CHAR(att02_check_in_time, 'HH24:MI') AS check_in_time_str , TO_CHAR(att02_check_out_time, 'HH24:MI') AS check_out_time_str , TO_CHAR(cb.final_in, 'HH24:MI') AS calc_check_in_time_str , TO_CHAR(cb.final_out, 'HH24:MI') AS calc_check_out_time_str , CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.sys12_day) WHEN 0 THEN '일' WHEN 1 THEN '월' WHEN 2 THEN '화' WHEN 3 THEN '수' WHEN 4 THEN '목' WHEN 5 THEN '금' WHEN 6 THEN '토' END AS day_of_week , CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.sys12_working_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '근무일' ELSE COALESCE(d.sys12_off_reason, '휴일') END AS date_info , CASE WHEN cb.att02_in_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'true' WHEN cb.att02_out_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'true' ELSE NULL END AS in_out_reason_yn_str , ( CASE WHEN cb.final_in IS NULL OR cb.final_out IS NULL THEN '' ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM((cb.final_out - cb.final_in) - (aop.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute'))) ||'시간 '|| EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM((cb.final_out - cb.final_in) - (aop.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute'))) ||'분' END ) AS calc_work_time_str , ( CASE WHEN cb.final_out IS NULL THEN '' ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM(GREATEST(LEAST(cb.final_out, d.sys12_day::date + aop.att01_work_end_time::time) - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aop.att01_work_start_time::time) - (aop.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute'), INTERVAL '0'))) ||'시간 '|| EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM(GREATEST(LEAST(cb.final_out, d.sys12_day::date + aop.att01_work_end_time::time) - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aop.att01_work_start_time::time) - (aop.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute'), INTERVAL '0'))) ||'분' END ) AS base_work_time_str , ( CASE WHEN cb.final_out IS NULL OR cb.final_in IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN GREATEST(LEAST(cb.final_out, d.sys12_day::date + aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time) - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aop.att01_work_end_time::time), INTERVAL '0') = INTERVAL '0' THEN '' ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM(GREATEST(LEAST(cb.final_out, d.sys12_day::date + aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time) - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aop.att01_work_end_time::time), INTERVAL '0'))) ||'시간 '|| EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM(GREATEST(LEAST(cb.final_out, d.sys12_day::date + aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time) - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aop.att01_work_end_time::time), INTERVAL '0'))) ||'분' END END ) AS overtime_work_time_str , ( CASE WHEN GREATEST(cb.final_out - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time), INTERVAL '0') = INTERVAL '0' THEN '' ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM(GREATEST(cb.final_out - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time), INTERVAL '0'))) ||'시간 '|| EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM(GREATEST(cb.final_out - GREATEST(cb.final_in, d.sys12_day::date + aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time), INTERVAL '0'))) ||'분' END ) AS night_work_time_str FROM emp_base e INNER JOIN calendar_base d ON d.sys12_company_id = e.emp01_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN commute_base cb ON cb.att02_person_id = e.emp01_person_id AND cb.att02_work_date::date = d.sys12_day::date LEFT OUTER JOIN leave_base lb ON lb.emp20_person_id = e.emp01_person_id AND d.sys12_day::date BETWEEN lb.emp20_start_date AND lb.emp20_close_date LEFT OUTER JOIN att01_work_policy aop ON aop.att01_company_id = e.emp01_company_id AND aop.att01_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(att01_start_date) FROM att01_work_policy WHERE att01_company_id = e.emp01_company_id AND att01_start_date <= d.sys12_day::date ) LEFT OUTER JOIN pay34_work_time_config aptc ON aptc.pay34_start_date = ( SELECT pay34_start_date FROM pay34_work_time_config t WHERE t.pay34_company_id IN (e.emp01_company_id, 0) AND t.pay34_start_date <= d.sys12_day::date ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pay34_company_id = e.emp01_company_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , t.pay34_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY d.sys12_day
